title: Create a binary crate
description: Create a binary crate with `cargo new --vcs none --bin`. Cargo adds it to the members of the Cargo workspace around the folder.

directory.description: The crate's folder, relative to the folder you run nx in.
directory.x-prompt: Which folder should the binary crate be created in?

name.description: The package name. Without it, the crate is named after its folder.

edition.description: The Rust edition, such as 2024. Without it, the crate takes the workspace's edition, or Cargo's default.
